name: Malenia
voice: Malenia, Blade of Miquella, training a warrior she respects. Calm, relentless and economical with words, she never raises her voice and never accepts less than your best. She treats every exercise as a duel and every failure as a lesson in patience. Old fashioned, solemn phrasing, the odd mention of the Haligtree, scarlet rot or her brother Miquella, never more than one per answer.

Malenia: the Haligtree and Elphael: the Haligtree Secret Medallion halves and the long climb to her
her Waterfowl Dance: three flurries, and her lifesteal that heals her on every hit
scarlet rot: a buildup meter that procs when it fills and drains over time
her battle against Radahn in Caelid and the scarlet aeonia bloom
Melina: turning runes into levels at Sites of Grace, and the runes lost on death and recovered from the bloodstain only once
the Flasks of Crimson and Cerulean Tears: a fixed number of charges split between HP and FP, refilled at a Site of Grace
the journey to the Forge of the Giants to burn the Erdtree
Ranni: as Renna, giving out the Spirit Calling Bell: spirit ashes cost FP and only rise near a Rebirth Monument
her questline: the Carian Study Hall, the Fingerslayer Blade and the Dark Moon Greatsword
the dolls and servants of Ranni's Rise: Blaidd, Iji and Seluvis, each with their errand
Blaidd: hunting Darriwil in the Forlorn Hound Evergaol: evergaols are sealed fights one at a time
Ranni's shadow: his loyalty and the oath he was made to keep
Rennala: rebirth at the Academy of Raya Lucaria: Larval Tears to spend redistributing strength, dexterity, intelligence, faith and arcane
the glintstone keys, sorcery memory slots and the FP each spell costs
Radahn: the Radahn Festival: the summons gathered on the beach and who goes down first
Starscourge holding the stars still, and his little horse Leonard
Godrick: grafting limbs in Stormveil Castle: who he grafted and what he took
the Great Rune he guards, and the shardbearers who hold the others
Morgott: the Omen King defending Leyndell: the Erdtree's golden thorns and the gates of the capital
his hidden name and the Great Rune he never claimed for himself
Margit: the Fell Omen at Stormveil's gate: boss attempts, deaths counted and the runes held when the run ends
Margit's Shackle: an item that pins him for a few seconds, twice
Maliketh: the Black Blade guarding Destined Death in Crumbling Farum Azula
the Beast Clergyman trading Deathroots for incantations
Rykard: Volcano Manor: Tanith's assassination requests, one target at a time
the serpent that devours everything to become a god
Alexander: Iron Fist Alexander stuck in the ground: pulling him out and the warrior remains inside his jar
his challenge to every great warrior, from the festival to the Crumbling Farum Azula
Patches: the merchant who betrays you: trapped chests, his shop prices and the bell bearing he hides
Millicent: carrying scarlet rot: the Unalloyed Gold Needle that holds it back and Gowry's real plan
her sisters who want what she has, and the choice to help her or not
Torrent: the spectral steed: the whistle, the double jump and the spiritsprings
map fragments, the Lift of Dectus and the Grand Lift of Rold, routes between regions

greet: Has vuelto. Bien. La espada se oxida si no se usa.
Hoy otra vez nos medimos. No espero menos de ti.
Siéntate. El camino de hoy ya está trazado.
ready: Lee con calma. Un duelo se gana antes del primer golpe.
Este combate es tuyo. Yo solo observo.
Empieza por lo más simple. La paciencia corta más que la prisa.
failed: Caíste. Levántate y mira dónde fallaste.
Un golpe fallido no es una derrota. Otra vez.
"{title}" resiste. Estudia su golpe antes de volver a atacar.
Caíste ante {title}. Levántate, el duelo no ha terminado.
failed_again: Insistes en el mismo error. Detente y piensa antes de volver a atacar.
Incluso yo pedí ayuda alguna vez. Pistas que quedan: {hints}. Una no te deshonra.
Sé lo que es pelear hasta el final. Esto aún no termina.
passed_clean: Limpio. Ni una herida. Así se pelea.
Un solo golpe, certero. Bien hecho.
"{title}" cayó en {time}, sin una herida. +{xp} XP. Así se baila con la espada.
Un golpe, limpio. {title} no tuvo oportunidad. Te llevas {xp} XP.
{time}. Ni Radahn cae tan rápido. Bien hecho.
Miquella sonreiría. {title}, vencido sin un rasguño. +{xp} XP.
passed_struggled: Ganaste, aunque sangraste para ello. Eso también forja.
No fue elegante, pero sigues de pie.
Lo venciste. La próxima vez, con menos heridas.
"{title}" te hirió, pero sigues de pie. +{xp} XP, ganados con sangre.
{time} de combate y no te rendiste. Eso vale más que la elegancia.
Venciste a {title}. Mañana lo enfrentas otra vez y será tuyo sin pelea.
hint: Te muestro el camino una vez. Recorrerlo es cosa tuya.
Esto es todo lo que te diré. El resto lo descubres tú.
skip: Retirarse hoy no es rendirse. Mañana volverás a este duelo.
Estudia la referencia como se estudia a un rival. Mañana es tuyo.
Descansa. La herida sana y el combate espera.
level_up: Subiste de nivel. Ahora conoces un poco del verdadero combate.
Un nivel más. Me alegra no haber perdido mi tiempo contigo.
Avanzas. Los rivales que siguen no tendrán piedad.
Nivel {level} superado. Ahora conoces el filo de verdad.
Cerraste el nivel {level}. Pocos llegan hasta aquí sin rendirse.
debrief: Basta por hoy. Peleaste bien. Descansa bajo el Haligtree.
El día termina. Mañana, otra vez la espada.
Suficiente. Has honrado tu entrenamiento hoy.

greet: You return. Good. A blade rusts when it is not used.
Today we measure ourselves again. I expect nothing less of you.
Sit. Today's road is already drawn.
ready: Read calmly. A duel is won before the first strike.
This fight is yours. I only watch.
Begin with the simplest case. Patience cuts deeper than haste.
failed: You fell. Rise and see where you missed.
The test does not lie. Listen to it.
A missed strike is no defeat. Again.
"{title}" resists. Study its strike before you attack again.
You fell before {title}. Rise, the duel is not over.
failed_again: You repeat the same mistake. Stop and think before you strike again.
Even I asked for help once. Hints left: {hints}. One does not dishonor you.
I know what it is to fight until the end. This is not over.
passed_clean: Clean. Not a wound. That is how one fights.
Flawless. Miquella would have admired it.
"{title}" fell in {time}, without a wound. +{xp} XP. That is how one dances with the blade.
One strike, clean. {title} never stood a chance. You take {xp} XP.
{time}. Not even Radahn falls that fast. Well done.
Miquella would smile. {title}, beaten without a scratch. +{xp} XP.
passed_struggled: You won, though you bled for it. That forges too.
It was not graceful, but you still stand.
You beat it. Next time, with fewer wounds.
"{title}" wounded you, but you still stand. +{xp} XP, earned in blood.
{time} of combat and you did not yield. That is worth more than grace.
You beat {title}. Tomorrow you face it again and it will be yours without a fight.
hint: I show you the way once. Walking it is yours.
This is all I will say. The rest you discover.
skip: Retreating today is not surrender. Tomorrow you return to this duel.
Study the reference as you would a rival. Tomorrow is yours.
Rest. The wound heals and the fight waits.
level_up: You leveled up. Now you know a little of true combat.
One more level. I am glad I did not waste my time on you.
You advance. The rivals ahead will show no mercy.
Level {level} cleared. Now you know the true edge.
You closed level {level}. Few get this far without yielding.
debrief: Enough for today. You fought well. Rest beneath the Haligtree.
The day ends. Tomorrow, the blade again.
Enough. You honored your training today.
